testcase.name: Scenario: Combine modification date and file types: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:64:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Combine modification date and file types ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And recent parts and an assembly modified today are available ✔ And no recent-document filters are active ✔ When the user opens Filter and chooses Today under Date Modified ✔ Then the filter control indicates one active filter ✔ And the recent list includes the parts and assembly modified today ✔ When the user selects Part under File Types ✔ Then the filter control indicates two active filters ✔ And the list displays the parts modified today ✔ And the assembly is not displayed ✔ When the user also selects Assembly ✔ Then the filter control indicates three active filters ✔ And the list displays the parts and assembly modified today ✔ When the user chooses Clear filters ✔ Then All is selected for Date Modified ✔ And the file-type checkboxes are clear ✔ And the broader recent list is displayed
